title: Liminal Threshold Crossing

source_refs.author: Arnold van Gennep and Victor Turner
source_refs.title: Rites of Passage / The Ritual Process

observed_structure: A subject leaves a prior status, crosses a bounded interval, and enters a changed relation.
The threshold makes the before-and-after distinction observable through space, sound, costume, or access.
transferable_structure: Make status change legible through a consequential boundary crossing with a clear before, interval, and after.
non_transferable_surface: Do not copy sacred rites, regalia, chants, or culturally specific initiation practices without provenance and permission.
